node_6.subject: Tom Moreno
node_6.description: This is Tom Moreno's plan for Monday February 13: wake up and complete the morning routine at 7:00 am, breakfast with Jane. Given his "rude and aggressive" tendencies, he might bark at the newspaper before his first cup of coffee, , , then head home to eat dinner with Jane. He'll vent about the day, especially any local politics talk, and maybe read a bit of campaign news before bed.
